item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD gains as BoE sticks to slow rate cuts
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades with mild gains around 1.3510 during the early European session on Tuesday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) as the Bank of England (BoE) guided that monetary policy will remain on a gradual downward path.

item.title: Gold attracts some buyers amid safe-haven flows, FOMC Minutes in focus
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) edges higher above $4,350 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The precious metal recovers some lost ground after falling 4.5% in the previous session, which was gold's largest single-day loss since October.

item.title: S&P 500 E‑Mini (ES) maintains bullish structure, eyeing further upside [Video]
item.description: The S&P 500 E-Mini Futures (ES) continues to advance, breaking into new all-time highs and confirming that the prevailing trend remains firmly bullish.

item.title: USD/CHF pulls back from 0.7900 as safe-haven demand supports Swiss Franc
item.description: USD/CHF loses ground after two days of gains, trading around 0.7880 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The Swiss KOF Leading Indicator will be eyed later, which could offer future trends of the overall economic activity.

item.title: USD/INR flattens while outlook remains upbeat due to consistent FIIs selling
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades almost flat against the US Dollar (USD) at the open on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Sees more downside below 1.3640
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades almost flat around 1.3685 during the late Asian trading session on Tuesday. The Loonie pair consolidates ahead of the release of Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes of the December meeting in the late New York session.

item.title: EUR/JPY holds steady below 184.00, BoJ signals further tightening
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades on a flat note around 183.80 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Expectation of additional rate hikes by the Bank of Japan (BoJ) in 2026 could provide some support to the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Euro (EUR).
